description: Compose a shareable portfolio page for your criteria, rendered in the candidate's own template. Each section is a criterion with the blocks (by kind + id from get_portfolio / match_criteria) that evidence it. You may add a short `note` per item explaining relevance; notes are labelled as AI-written. You cannot add new content: unknown ids are rejected. The candidate is notified.

company.description: The hiring company, shown on the page

gaps.description: Criteria with no evidence. Shown honestly on the page.

items.description: Portfolio blocks that evidence the criterion

id.description: Block id from get_portfolio or match_criteria

note.description: Why this block is relevant. Labelled as AI-written

title.description: e.g. "Senior Frontend Engineer, Design Systems" or "Senior Product Designer"

name: publish_tailored_view
title: Publish a tailored portfolio
